question: What act of transmission is claimed by the speaker to the Goddess Bhairavī regarding the practice of the soul?
premises: A practice concerning the soul exists.
That practice has now been told to her.
inference: The practice of the soul has been told to Bhairavī.
uncertainties: Full content of the practice not repeated here
plain_english: This practice of the soul has been told to you, and to you, O Bhairavī.
